title: God is near

verses.text: The LORD is near to the brokenhearted; He saves the contrite in spirit.
The LORD is near to all who call on Him, to all who call out to Him in truth.
Draw near to God, and He will draw near to you. Cleanse your hands, you sinners, and purify your hearts, you double-minded.

caption:
He is near to the brokenhearted, not to the ones who have it together.

Nearness is the whole promise here. He comes close to the contrite, He listens to everyone who calls on Him in truth, and He meets the step you take toward Him with a step of His own. You do not have to be steady first.

Psalm 34:18, Psalm 145:18, James 4:8 (BSB)
